item.title: 1.0.6-beta.16
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.16
- Meet Mellow as a local-first productivity suite for agents and their humans, with clearer onboarding and language across workspaces, responsibilities, tools, knowledge, and permissions. - Enjoy a more welcoming Mellow Cloud experience, with consistent agent and workspace pages, clearer connection settings, and centered sign-in actions. - Keep iOS confirmations centered with a visible Cancel action, and keep error banners clear of navigation and content. - Make iOS primary buttons readable in light and dark appearance with every Mellow coat. - Find renamed settings through Management search and the updated in-app guide. - The companion iOS update lets you forget an old saved Mac even when it is offline or its pairing has expired, while preserving your other Macs and their drafts.
Mellow Cloud is optional. Voice and live avatars require configured services; physical-device concepts are distinct from live avatars. Air-gapped use requires local dependencies. The iPhone companion requires a paired Mac and is distributed through TestFlight. This release does not deploy hosted services.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.14
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.14
- Fix paired-phone calls and local chat continuation after saving an ordinary local conversation. - Handle speech-worker announcement races during call startup while retaining worker-role, session, and recovery checks. - Keep video renderers and delegated media participants outside the speech worker's privileged RPC path.
Calls require a compatible backend and call worker. Video rendering can take several minutes to start from idle. This beta does not guarantee cold-start latency or seamless network switching. The iPhone companion is distributed separately through TestFlight; this release does not deploy hosted services.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.13
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.13
- Add automated iOS signing, validation, and TestFlight uploads alongside tagged Mac releases. Apple processing and beta review remain separate steps. - Add paired-Mac support for native iPhone voice and video calls, including protected video admission and the agent’s configured portrait. - Allow cold video-renderer preparation to finish without applying the shorter missing-worker recovery deadline. - Improve portrait delivery through the relay. The iPhone companion caches bounded portrait thumbnails locally while video rendering uses the original image. - Refine the iPhone call interface with separate voice/video buttons, consistent controls, and camera-off preview behavior. Startup failures identify the failing connection stage.
Physical iPhone testing confirmed visible agent video and spoken replies through the paired Mac. One cold renderer startup took about 3 minutes 40 seconds; a subsequent warm admission took about 6 seconds. These observations are not a latency guarantee or qualification of every model/provider.
Calls require a compatible backend, call worker, and configured video-rendering service. This Mac update does not deploy those services. The iPhone companion is distributed separately through TestFlight. Calls remain foreground-only; camera transport does not automatically provide model visual context.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.12
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.12
- Use an agent’s portrait in local-agent video calls while your Mac keeps ownership of the conversation, model, tools and speech. Voice-only calls do not request a video renderer. - Preserve original portrait images and custom portraits when changing themes, and keep Settings readable in the selected appearance. - Open the selected conversation when clicking an agent card, dismissing Settings so the chat is immediately visible. - Improve call startup, cancellation and cleanup. Retry eligible timed-out call requests with the same conversation item, and retire an unreachable worker when bounded recovery fails.
Local-agent video was checked in the app with an audible answer, a follow-up calculation, visible lip sync and a spoken Stop interruption. Cold startup and a warm restart were observed separately; transport reconnect was not measured. These checks do not establish support for every model, voice provider or deployment.
Animated local-agent video requires a compatible CAST deployment, call worker and configured portrait-rendering facility. Installing this desktop update does not deploy those services. The iOS companion limitations described in beta.10 remain unchanged.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.11
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.11
- Bring workspace agents, tools, publishing, and Mac hosting into a consistent Mellow interface, with Settings in a centered dialog over your conversation. - Open a conversation directly from an agent card, and preserve the existing workspace connection when signing in again. - Improve local task continuity so follow-up requests use the latest conversation context, including after reconnecting or reopening Mellow. - Improve local-agent voice calls and cloud-avatar call handling, including pending starts, call controls, and ending a session. Prevent separate CAST deployments that share a media service from removing each other's call rooms. - Fix browser edits disappearing from React-controlled input and text fields after the page updates. - Fix file-history persistence and improve translations across the workspace interface.
Local-agent voice was checked with an audible answer and a follow-up calculation; cloud-avatar video and an audible reply were checked separately. These checks do not establish support for every model, voice provider, or deployment. Local models can still add unsolicited text to otherwise correct answers.
Workspace publishing and call improvements require a compatible CAST deployment and call worker. This beta does not add local-agent animated portrait video or change the iOS companion limitations described in beta.10.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.10
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.10
- Add Mac support for the native Mellow iPhone and iPad companion, with encrypted connections and QR-first pairing. - Let paired owners manage supported agent and project configuration, Conversation preferences, and engine settings through reviewed changes on the Mac. - Add protected chat editing, regeneration, exchange removal, retained-task replies, and response-inspection endpoints for compatible mobile clients. - Improve retained conversation continuity, project context, model options and favourites, and authenticated agent portraits. - Show captured sampling overrides accurately in Insights instead of reporting an output limit that was not requested.
This is an incremental beta and an iOS companion support preview, not complete desktop parity. Some desktop settings, project file and knowledge-content management, and voice/call features remain unavailable on iOS. Complete paired-device, lifecycle, media, accessibility, and iPad validation is still in progress. An intermittent rapid Inspector-dismissal/navigation issue remains under investigation. The iOS app is distributed separately; updating the Mac does not install it.
Existing pairing and owner-approval requirements remain in force. Update the Mac before using mobile features that require these new endpoints.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.9
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.9
- Use an agent’s portrait for animated avatar calls when a compatible GPU call service is configured. - Keep the agent’s configured voice, model, tools, and conversation history during avatar calls. - Improve call recovery after network interruptions and avoid reusing retired call workers. - Prepare microphone and camera permissions before joining, and cancel pending call setup cleanly. - Correct Teams chat stream handling and add privacy-safe diagnostics for calls that end unexpectedly.
Avatar calls require a separately configured compatible service. Teams avatar attendance remains experimental; a complete Teams validation for every agent is not included in this beta. Ordinary typed chat remains text-only.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.8
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.8
- Keep one live conversation owner when reopening a completed background or channel chat. - Preserve completed conversation history when navigating to another chat or starting a new one. - Wait for a restored tab’s transcript before appending a grouped channel follow-up.
Agent settings, Slack app bindings, credentials, and model defaults are unchanged.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.7
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.7
- Show the selected Slack app's receive status instead of the inactive original connection. - Load channels and direct messages for Slack apps without optional group-DM access. - Preserve manually entered channel and sender access when Slack discovery is incomplete.
- Correct inbound message authorization for separately connected Slack apps.
- Summarize all active Slack apps in the Channels card and diagnostics, including missing or unhealthy receivers.
Agent settings, credentials, and existing Slack app bindings are preserved.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.6
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.6
- Connect multiple Slack apps in one workspace, each bound to its own Mellow agent. - Keep each app's credentials, receiver, conversations and replies separate. - Adopt an existing Slack connection without duplicating its receiver or losing its thread history. - Add direct-message access for approved people, with recipient checks before reading or sending.
Existing agents, model and voice settings are preserved. Live validation of the seven-agent Slack setup on M4 is scheduled after installation through Mellow's updater.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.5
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.5
- Connect Mellow Cloud workspaces and browse their agents from the main app. - Submit workspace tasks, follow their progress, cancel running work, and revisit saved results. - Run authorized workspace tasks on this Mac while keeping host access explicit and revocable. - Improve workspace sign-in recovery and show a clear connection error when a service is unavailable. - Preserve task results across restarts and prevent interrupted work from replaying automatically.
Files, memory, and execution remain on the selected host. Workspace task execution requires a compatible workspace service and an explicitly connected Mac host. Reconnect the host after its connection or authority is lost; interrupted tasks are not replayed automatically.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.4
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.4
- Fix delegated agent tasks failing when using a ChatGPT subscription model. - Preserve explicitly configured provider limits and existing agent settings. - Support awaiting a specialist's result during a call and returning it through the coordinating agent.
ChatGPT subscription transport does not accept an output-token cap; delegated tasks retain their time, turn and cancellation controls. Long-running background results do not automatically trigger speech after a call turn ends.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.3
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.3
- Open paired Mac conversations in their own device tab group. - Switch between host conversations while keeping drafts and tracked work available. - Reopen saved host conversations after restarting Mellow, with their history staying on the paired Mac.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.2
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6-beta.2
- Calls now share the main workspace with your conversation, keeping chat and other controls accessible. - Open chat, share a call, toggle your camera, and end a call directly from the call controls. - Participant video tiles adapt to wider and smaller windows, with your camera shown separately. - Improved camera permissions and clearer camera errors. - Refined window tabs, panel dividers, and the sign-in return page for a more consistent Mellow experience.
Video is shared with call participants; it is not sent to the agent’s model.

item.title: 1.0.6-beta.1
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.6 Preview 1
This preview improves agent speech and keeps call controls close to your conversation.
- Speech streams continuously with playback buffering that adapts to slower connections. Your agent's configured voice and speech settings remain in use. - Interrupting or leaving stops the active speech stream. Call startup handles worker connection timing more reliably. - A compact call panel stays with your chat, with microphone, camera, video visibility and end-call controls. Navigate away and return to the same conversation to resume its controls.
Download **Mellow-1.0.6-beta.1.dmg** for Apple silicon Macs, or enable **Beta Updates** in Mellow. Existing agents, settings and conversations are retained. Stable-channel users are not automatically offered this preview.
Calls require an authenticated Cloud workspace and configured call services. Speech has been checked on M4 against the Develop workspace, including a user listening check for short and longer replies and interruption. This preview does not establish new Teams, iPhone relay, or every device/network combination as qualified. Slow speech generation can increase the initial wait before playback.

# Mellow 1.0.5
## Agent voices and models in calls
- Call replies use the agent’s selected voice and the Mac’s configured speech provider, model, and speed or temperature settings. - Meeting conversations refresh the agent’s configured model before each spoken turn. Direct calls preserve an explicit model selection in the chat. - An unavailable model or voice produces an error instead of silently switching to a different configuration. - Meeting audio stays in the call. The agent’s speak tool cannot also play its response through the host Mac’s speakers.
## Compatibility and testing status
This build requires a matching updated call worker. Installing the app alone does not update the hosted service. Calls remain in testing; a final live Teams voice check and hosted rollout are pending. Speech recognition continues to use the call service’s transcription provider. Desktop automatic read-aloud is separate from speech in an explicitly started call.
Existing agent settings and conversations are retained. This build targets Apple silicon Macs; no Windows, Linux, or Android application build is included.

# Mellow 1.0.4
This update fixes update detection and includes the latest agent-call controls and audio-routing improvements.
## Updates that move forward
Mellow now uses a separate numeric build version so the updater can distinguish releases correctly. Earlier 1.0.3 previews could appear equal to one another and incorrectly report that no update was available. The displayed version remains 1.0.4.
## Calls and meetings
- Return to an active call or meeting from chat to reach its controls and leave. - Meeting and paired-call hosts keep media off the host Mac's speakers and microphone, including after network reconnects. Direct calls retain normal local audio. - Call replies wait for the agent's complete response. Calls retain the existing agent and conversation.
## Install or update
Download **Mellow-1.0.4.dmg** and move Mellow to Applications, or use **Check for Updates** in Mellow. This release is for Apple silicon Macs. Existing agent settings and conversations are retained.
## Call feature status
Calls and meetings remain in testing. They require an authenticated Cloud workspace with matching call and meeting services configured; installing the app does not deploy those services. Teams voice was exercised with a local development workspace. Hosted deployment, Teams text-chat delivery, the complete leave/rejoin lifecycle, and iPhone relay calls are not yet fully qualified. Multiple speakers are not yet reliably attributed by name in the agent's transcript.
Local models and configured providers remain separate from Cloud workspace access. No Windows, Linux, or Android application build is included.

item.title: 1.0.3-beta.3
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.3 Preview 3
An Apple silicon preview of agent calls and meeting controls, with fixes for audio routing and reply completion.
## What's new
- Agent calls use the existing agent and saved conversation. Repeated joins to the same meeting continue its conversation. - Return to an active call or meeting from chat to reach its controls and leave the meeting. - Meeting and paired-call hosts keep media off the Mac's speakers and microphone, including after a network reconnect. Direct calls on the Mac retain their normal audio controls. - Call replies wait for the agent's complete response before delivery.
## Local model updates
- Discover a smaller, curated catalog with clear model sources. - Download Visca's independently converted Qwen3 1.7B MLX 4-bit model, with a Mellow model card, conversion details, and original-author attribution. - Use Liquid's published LFM2.5 1.2B MLX 4-bit model for local chat. - Import compatible Hugging Face models directly. Existing installed models remain available, and downloads retain model licence and notice files. - Short numeric answers remain visible when streamed replies finish, and cached model weight sizes account for symbolic links.
The initial image catalog is empty; compatible image models can still be imported. Gemma is not included in this beta. Model downloads require an internet connection; downloaded local models run on your Mac. Tool support depends on the selected model. This beta does not introduce Windows, Linux, or Android builds.
## Install or update
Download **Mellow-1.0.3-beta.3.dmg** and move Mellow to Applications. Existing users can enable **Beta Updates** to receive the preview through the signed update feed. The stable channel does not automatically offer this beta.
## Preview scope
- Calls and meeting participation require an authenticated Cloud workspace with the matching call and meeting services configured. Installing this Mac app alone does not deploy or enable those services. - Teams voice has been exercised with a local development workspace. Hosted deployment and every account/network combination are not qualified by that test. - Teams text-chat delivery is still being verified. Do not rely on meeting chat for unattended work in this preview. - Multiple speakers are not yet reliably attributed by name in the agent's transcript. - iPhone relay calls and the complete leave/rejoin lifecycle remain in testing.
This is an opt-in testing preview, not a claim that every call, model, or device workflow is production-ready.

item.title: 1.0.3-beta.2
item.description:
# Mellow 1.0.3 Preview 2
A preview for Apple silicon Macs, with refreshed chat and model selection, quick and companion panels, clearer local-server recovery, and voice and pairing lifecycle improvements.
This update adds an original family of 37 Mellow vector icons across navigation and product actions. Routes and settings are unchanged; official provider logos and operating-system status symbols are preserved. Model cards use cleaner descriptions while source details remain available.
## Install or update
Download **Mellow-1.0.3-beta.2.dmg** from this release and move Mellow to Applications. Existing users can also enable **Beta Updates** in Mellow to receive this preview through the signed update feed. The default stable channel does not automatically offer this beta.
## What to expect
- Local models and configured providers remain separate from Cloud workspace access. Download a local model or connect a provider before chatting. - Cloud features require a configured, authenticated workspace and the appropriate permissions. Delegated agent work also requires published, eligible agents. Workspace sign-in does not supply independent cloud-model service credits. - The iPhone companion is still in user testing. Pairing, relay availability and model access depend on the host Mac; this release does not establish every phone/network combination as qualified. - Voice input requires microphone permission and a transcription model. Global insertion can additionally require Accessibility permission. Recognition quality depends on the microphone and environment. - This is a preview: final visual checks for every layout and end-to-end checks for every account/device flow are not complete. There are no Windows, Linux desktop or Android app downloads in this release.
The macOS package is Developer ID signed and notarized. Signing and notarization verify distribution integrity; they do not imply all external services or account flows are configured.

Mellow 1.0.2 for Apple silicon Macs.
- Redesigned settings and quick panel. - Signed automatic update support with an update-available prompt. - Unified update status in settings and the quick panel.
This prerelease is undergoing update/install qualification. Both the application and disk image have passed Apple notarization. General release promotion awaits the live upgrade and relaunch check.
Earlier builds with updates disabled require one manual installation of an update-enabled release.
